data.craftText: Beyond code, I hand-build and sculpt ceramic pottery. Tactile clay work requires patience, balance, and acute temporal awareness—respecting natural drying phases just as good architecture respects state evolution over time.
data.cynefinText: I apply the Cynefin framework (Simple, Complicated, Complex, Chaotic) to navigate software investment decisions. Understanding which domain a problem inhabits prevents over-engineering and aligns tech with true business goals.
